SUMMARY

Design transformation strategies that go beyond point automations to deliver full operating models - pairing technology with the ownership, governance, and customer experience needed to sustain the change. Technical & Analytical: R (Primary), SAS, Python, SQL, Power BI, UiPath, Power Automate, Blue Prism, SAP Signavio, MS Visio, statistical modelling, hypothesis testing, data-driven decision-making Data Expertise: HILDA, PISA; large-scale data analysis, qualitative & quantitative methods, ETL, insight generation, data validation, data mining Process Excellence: Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt), RCA, FMEA, Risk Analysis, Cost & Benefits Analysis, Value Stream Mapping, Process Mapping, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, Customer Journey Mapping, SOP Development, Process Standardisation Frameworks & Tools: ITIL, Design Thinking, BPR, Porter's 5 Forces, PESTLE, SWOT, RPA (Appian, Blue Prism, Kofax), OCR, JIRA, Confluence Business & Project Skills: Stakeholder Management, Management Consulting, Digital Transformation, Customer Lifecycle, Performance Reporting

Shyam Spectra Pvt Ltd Process Excellence Manager - Digital & Operational Excellence
